|lastmentioned = {{amol|34}}}}'''Vitalien''' was [[Warder]] to [[Sarene Nemdahl]], [[White Ajah]], despite that Whites rarely have Warders.

== Appearance ==
He was broad-shouldered and Sarene wrote poetry comparing him to a leopard and other powerful, graceful and dangerous animals. {{Ref|{{twotc}}, Vitalien}}

==History==
As the [[Last Battle]] approached, Sarene and Vitalien engaged in a tempestuous love affair.

== Activities ==
When Sarene [[Travel]]ed to [[Far Madding]], she left Vitalien behind in [[Cairhien]]. He then Traveled with [[Logain Ablar]] and [[Davram Bashere]] to [[Tear]] to find [[Rand al'Thor]] and Sarene.

He is present when Cadsuane breaks Semirhage.{{Ref/book|12|17}}

Vitalien continues to be by Sarene's side during [[Tarmon Gai'don]], where he fights in the valley of [[Thakan'dar]].

== Death ==
Vitalien was killed by [[Hessalam]] at Shayol Ghul.{{Ref/book|14|34}}
